# Part II {#sec-part2}

Part II covers topics beyond basic data manipulation functions and data visualization. It begins with [Chapter 4](@sec-04-statistical-tests), which discusses common statistical tests (a classical frequentist perspective). For readers who want to dive deeper into intermediate R functions, [Chapter 5](@sec-05-dive-deeper) covers R functions that create or import data sets from files, restructure data sets, and speed up execution. [Chapter 6](@sec06-r-rstudio) provides an overview of RStudio, an Interactive Development Environment (IDE) for crafting R scripts.
